courthouses.name: Main Courthouse — Department 1
courthouses.note: Historic courthouse. Per the court calendar: Mon Title IV-D, limited civil, small claims, and Juvenile (1:00 p.m.); Tue adoptions/guardianships/conservatorships, civil, family, probate; Wed–Fri trials and all other matters. Adult criminal calendars are in Dept. 2. Juvenile delinquency is heard here.

departments.label: Department 1
departments.note: Juvenile Mondays 1:00 p.m. per court calendar.

courthouses.name: Courthouse Annex — Department 2
courthouses.note: Criminal and traffic courtroom; the Criminal Clerk's Office is at 532 Oak St. Calendar: Tue 8:30 criminal & traffic pro per, Prop 36, misdemeanor/felony arraignments 12:30 p.m.; Wed 8:30 criminal, 10:30 prelims/court trials; 2nd & 4th Mon traffic arraignments and traffic trials. In-custody arraignments are held as needed — call (530) 458-5149 opt. 4 after 9 a.m.; in-custody defendants are often added the morning of court. Walk-in warrant court Tuesdays: check in at the clerk's office before 12:30 p.m. Note: the Self-Help page gives the annex address as '547 Market Street, Courthouse Annex' — conflicting with the location page (532 Oak St).

legal_aid.name: Legal Services of Northern California — Chico Office
legal_aid.serves: Colusa County seniors (LSNC lists Colusa only for its senior program)
legal_aid.what: For seniors in Colusa: consumer issues, basic estate planning, powers of attorney, advance health directives, elder abuse. Civil only; page does not list criminal or record-clearing help.
legal_aid.todo: No free criminal record-clearing (expungement) provider for Colusa County verified.

probation.name: Colusa County Probation Department
probation.note: Fax (530) 458-2895. Juveniles arrested in Colusa County are booked at the Probation Department.

programs.name: Prop 36 calendar
programs.summary: The court calendar lists a 'Criminal Prop 36' calendar Tuesdays 8:30 a.m. in Dept. 2. The court site does not describe the program.
programs.todo: No program description found; ask your attorney about eligibility.

programs.name: Walk-in court for outstanding warrants
programs.summary: Tuesdays. Check in at the Clerk's Office, 532 Oak Street, before 12:30 p.m. — anyone checking in later will not be seen.

programs.name: Self-Help Center
programs.summary: Free help for unrepresented people (family law, name change, restraining orders, civil harassment, small claims, guardianship) — not criminal defense. Mon–Wed 8:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m.

jails.name: Colusa County Jail
jails.phone_note: Jail main line. Visiting info/appointments: (530) 458-0649 (book at least one day ahead). Sheriff's Office (24/7): (530) 458-0200. Jail does not accept incoming calls or take messages.
jails.note: Holds up to 92 people (pretrial and sentenced). Separate visiting schedules for female and male incarcerated persons; two 30-minute visits/week, government photo ID required. Money: lobby kiosk 24/7 or Access Corrections. Court: criminal arraignments are in Dept. 2 (Courthouse Annex); in-custody arraignments held as needed.

jails.name: Tri-County Juvenile Rehabilitation Facility (out of county)
jails.note: Colusa Probation's page says arrested youth are booked at Colusa Probation and may then be taken to this facility in Marysville (Yuba County). Juvenile calendar is Dept. 1, Mondays 1:00 p.m. per the court calendar.
jails.todo: Facility phone/visiting not on Colusa pages; see the operating county's site.
